title: Pattern Matching with LIKE
description: Find employees whose last name starts with 'S' using LIKE.

data.text: Write a query to find all employees whose last name starts with the letter 'S'.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName
FROM Employees
WHERE LastName LIKE 'S%'
ORDER BY LastName;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: LIKE supports wildcards: % matches zero or more characters, _ matches exactly one character. 'S%' matches any last name starting with S. 'S%n' would match names like Smith, Stevenson. Use LIKE carefully on large tables — it prevents index usage.
